results.description:
For fans of all seasons, Claire Raye brings you a brand new book series set around your favorite holidays featuring laughs, love and of course a little bit of steam. Each book can be read as a standalone and happily ever afters are guaranteed! 

Heidi Swanson has always loved Halloween, just about as much she's loved her brother's best friend. And  acting on those feelings has never happened because there's nothing scarier than unrequited love.

Andrew Warner is as clueless as the day is long when it comes to realizing his best friend's sister has a crush on him. Despite being a medical student, his smarts lie solely in the academic department. 

When Heidi is selected to compete in a Halloween haunted hotel weekend to win $10,000, she knows she needs to choose her partner wisely. Selecting her brother is a no-brainer, but when he can't attend he suggests sending Andrew in his place.

Spending the weekend together in a spooky old hotel feels scarier than the ghosts they say lurk between the walls. But as a broke college student Heidi knows she can't turn down the opportunity. It's Andrew joining her that could be the scariest part of all. 

Will they risk their lives and fall in love or will it be one freaked up mess?
